queries.query: least ambiguous set-valued classifiers conformal LAC softmax score
queries.rationale: LAC (1 - softmax of true class) is the base nonconformity score in all three variants; need its original set-valued-classifier source.

queries.query: adaptive prediction sets APS RAPS conformal classification regularization
queries.rationale: Evaluator runs APS and RAPS as baselines on identical synthetic softmax data; final score margin over best baseline (+0.039, CI [0.027,0.050]) is the headline comparison.

queries.query: Mondrian conformal prediction class-conditional label-conditional validity
queries.rationale: Chosen configurations are Mondrian (class-conditional for K<=10, confidence-bin for K>10); classwise baseline also in evaluator.

queries.query: clustered conformal prediction many classes class-conditional coverage
queries.rationale: K in {10,50,100} with limited per-class calibration data; confidence-bin grouping for K>10 relates to clustering/grouping remedies for class-conditional coverage.

queries.query: weighted conformal prediction covariate shift label shift importance weights
queries.rationale: Best configuration adds gated domain-classifier importance weights (test mass at +inf, effective-sample-size margins); shift gap fell from 0.061 to 0.020 in search runs.

queries.query: density ratio estimation probabilistic classifier importance weighting covariate shift
queries.rationale: Weights come from a cross-fitted ridge-logistic domain classifier with a held-out shift-detection gate, an implied density-ratio-by-classification literature.

queries.query: conformal prediction conditional coverage impossibility group-conditional guarantees
queries.rationale: Worst-slice coverage gap (class/size/difficulty strata) stays 0.04-0.07 despite exact marginal validity (~0.001-0.0003 gap); must cite limits of distribution-free conditional coverage and group-conditional methods.

queries.query: conformal prediction conditional coverage via quantile regression of nonconformity scores
queries.rationale: Third variant used group-indicator pinball quantile-regression thresholds with out-of-fold offset and exact fallback; it gave identical scores to the second variant (fallback/no gain), a result needing this literature.

queries.query: size-stratified coverage metric evaluating conformal classifiers adaptiveness
queries.rationale: Reliability protocol is multi-axis (marginal gap, worst-slice gap, set-size ratio, shift gap, negative controls); need prior evaluation metrics for set-valued classifiers.

queries.query: compositional data analysis simplex log-ratio transformation Aitchison geometry
queries.rationale: Outputs are softmax simplex vectors (Aitchison framing); motivates simplex-valued outputs and what is and is not exploited by scalar-score conformal methods.

result_driven_themes: Exact marginal validity coexists with residual worst-slice coverage gap
Importance weighting reduces shift coverage gap but increases set size
Quantile-regression conditional thresholds gave no measurable gain over weighted Mondrian in search
Beats best baseline on final evaluation with CI excluding zero
